change_summary: Ran paired backtests with and without `--replay-llm` over the current primary window (`2025-10-23 -> 2026-04-20`) and over the only archive-covered micro window (`2026-04-10 -> 2026-04-20`). No strategy code changed. The primary window improved mechanically (`EV 0.3572 -> 0.3775`), but replay covered only 5 of 122 trading days and only 3 presented signals. The archive-covered micro window likewise contained only 3 signals total, 2 vetoes, and 1 executed trade. The prior comparison window (`2025-04-23 -> 2025-10-22`) had zero LLM coverage, so Gate 4 multi-window validation is impossible today.

delta_metrics.note: The apparent primary-window uplift is generated from only three covered candidate signals in one late-April cluster. Two vetoes removed one loser and one would-be unobserved candidate; there is no second covered comparison window to test stability. This is not enough evidence to accept `LLM soft ranking` as unlocked alpha.

hypothesis: `LLM soft ranking` is now the highest-value remaining alpha direction, so the first question is whether current replay coverage is already large enough to treat the observed `--replay-llm` uplift as credible rather than as a tiny-sample artifact.

llm_metrics.llm_attribution_metric: replay coverage days + signals presented/vetoed/passed + veto_rate

market_regime_summary.primary: current converged A+B stack with a late-April covered tail
market_regime_summary.window_1: covered micro window only; too short for stable inference
market_regime_summary.window_2: older comparison window with zero LLM archive coverage

next_retry_requires: Accumulate materially more `llm_prompt_resp_YYYYMMDD.json` files before treating replay deltas as alpha evidence
Do not resume A/B micro-tuning on the theory that LLM ranking is already proven; it is still blocked by coverage
When LLM alpha is revisited, compare at least two non-overlapping windows with real replay coverage rather than one covered tail and one uncovered history
notes: This closes the ambiguity created by the tempting `EV 0.3572 -> 0.3775` printout. `LLM soft ranking` remains the best conceptual direction, but it is still a measurement-blocked direction, not an unlocked one.
rejection_reason: Rejected as an alpha experiment because current LLM replay coverage is still too sparse to satisfy AGENTS.md Gate 4. The observed uplift is a tiny-sample effect from 5 covered trading days / 3 presented signals, and there is no non-overlapping covered window for stability validation.
